title: A2 Imitation Lesson | English Speaking Practice

segments.text: In this video, we're going to practice speaking with the imitation technique.
segments.ipa: /ɪn ðɪs ˈvɪdioʊ wir ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu ˈpræktəs ˈspikɪŋ wɪð ðə ˌɪməˈteɪʃən tɛkˈnik/

segments.text: It is one of the most effective ways that can improve your accent and fix your pronunciation problems.
segments.ipa: /ɪt ɪz wʌn ʌv ðə moʊst ɪˈfɛktɪv weɪz ðæt kæn ˌɪmˈpruv jɔr əkˈsɛnt ənd fɪks jɔr proʊˌnʌnsiˈeɪʃən ˈprɑbləmz/

segments.text: As a result, you will be able to speak English more clearly and confidently.
segments.ipa: /æz ə rɪˈzʌlt ju wɪl bi ˈeɪbəl tu spik ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ mɔr ˈklɪrli ənd ˈkɑnfədəntli/

segments.text: This technique teaches you to listen to the sounds and the patterns of English and then trains you to produce the same sounds yourself through repetition and controlled practice.
segments.ipa: /ðɪs tɛkˈnik ˈtitʃəz ju tu ˈlɪsən tu ðə saʊndz ənd ðə ˈpætərnz ʌv ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ənd ðɛn treɪnz ju tu prəˈdus ðə seɪm saʊndz jərˈsɛlf θru ˌrɛpəˈtɪʃən ənd kənˈtroʊld ˈpræktəs/

segments.text: We will explain each step so that you know exactly what you need to do.
segments.ipa: /wi wɪl ɪkˈspleɪn itʃ stɛp soʊ ðæt ju noʊ ɪɡˈzæktli wʌt ju nid tu du/

segments.text: This imitation lesson is designed for A2 learners.
segments.ipa: /ðɪs ˌɪməˈteɪʃən ˈlɛsən ɪz dɪˈzaɪnd fɔr ə ˈlɝnərz/

segments.text: To practice with the imitation technique, there are three simple steps that you need to follow.
segments.ipa: /tu ˈpræktəs wɪð ðə ˌɪməˈteɪʃən tɛkˈnik ðɛr ɑr θri ˈsɪmpəl stɛps ðæt ju nid tu ˈfɑloʊ/

segments.text: The first one is to listen and read.
segments.ipa: /ðə fɝst wʌn ɪz tu ˈlɪsən ənd rɛd/

segments.text: You just need to listen to what I say and read the words on the screen as I say them.
segments.ipa: /ju dʒʌst nid tu ˈlɪsən tu wʌt aɪ seɪ ənd rɛd ðə wɝdz ɑn ðə skrin æz aɪ seɪ ðɛm/

segments.text: Step two is to listen and repeat.
segments.ipa: /stɛp tu ɪz tu ˈlɪsən ənd rɪˈpit/

segments.text: You'll be listening to what I say, but then there'll be a pause so that you can repeat what I said.
segments.ipa: /jul bi ˈlɪsənɪŋ tu wʌt aɪ seɪ bʌt ðɛn ˈðɛrəl bi ə pɔz soʊ ðæt ju kæn rɪˈpit wʌt aɪ sɛd/

segments.text: You need to copy me exactly as you hear me.
segments.ipa: /ju nid tu ˈkɑpi mi ɪɡˈzæktli æz ju hir mi/

segments.text: You can repeat this step until the words are coming out of your mouth automatically.
segments.ipa: /ju kæn rɪˈpit ðɪs stɛp ənˈtɪl ðə wɝdz ɑr ˈkʌmɪŋ aʊt ʌv jɔr maʊθ ˌɔtəˈmætɪkli/

segments.text: And it's okay to practice many times before you move on to the third step.
segments.ipa: /ənd ɪts ˌoʊˈkeɪ tu ˈpræktəs ˈmɛni taɪmz bɪˈfɔr ju muv ɑn tu ðə θɝd stɛp/

segments.text: And step three is to shadow.
segments.ipa: /ənd stɛp θri ɪz tu ˈʃæˌdoʊ/

segments.text: You're going to be listening to me and saying what I'm saying at the same time.
segments.ipa: /jʊr ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu bi ˈlɪsənɪŋ tu mi ənd ˈseɪɪŋ wʌt aɪm ˈseɪɪŋ æt ðə seɪm taɪm/

segments.text: Although this step is the trickiest one, it's the best way to fine-tune your natural speaking skills.
segments.ipa: /ˌɔlˈðoʊ ðɪs stɛp ɪz ðə ˈtrɪkiəst wʌn ɪts ðə bɛst weɪ tu fine-tune jɔr ˈnætʃərəl ˈspikɪŋ skɪlz/

segments.text: And that's pretty much like practicing along to your favorite song.
segments.ipa: /ənd ðæts ˈprɪti mʌtʃ laɪk ˈpræktəsɪŋ əˈlɔŋ tu jɔr ˈfeɪvərɪt sɔŋ/

segments.text: In today's imitation lesson, you're going to listen to Alice describing a vacation.
segments.ipa: /ɪn təˈdeɪz ˌɪməˈteɪʃən ˈlɛsən jʊr ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu ˈlɪsən tu ˈæləs dɪˈskraɪbɪŋ ə veɪˈkeɪʃən/

segments.text: Let's get started.
segments.ipa: /lɛts ɡɛt ˈstɑrtɪd/

segments.text: Step one, listen and read.
segments.ipa: /stɛp wʌn ˈlɪsən ənd rɛd/

segments.text: Last winter, my boyfriend and I went on vacation to Kenya for 3 weeks.
segments.ipa: /læst ˈwɪntər maɪ ˈbɔɪˌfrɛnd ənd aɪ wɛnt ɑn veɪˈkeɪʃən tu ˈkɛnjə fɔr wiks/

segments.text: We rented a beach hut on a beautiful white sandy beach for the first week.
segments.ipa: /wi ˈrɛntɪd ə bitʃ hʌt ɑn ə ˈbjutəfəl waɪt ˈsændi bitʃ fɔr ðə fɝst wik/

segments.text: And the second week, we decided to go on safari.
segments.ipa: /ənd ðə ˈsɛkənd wik wi ˌdɪˈsaɪdɪd tu ɡoʊ ɑn səˈfɑri/

segments.text: We planned a perfect vacation, but it didn't begin well.
segments.ipa: /wi plænd ə pərˈfɛkt veɪˈkeɪʃən bʌt ɪt ˈdɪdənt bɪˈɡɪn wɛl/

segments.text: On the first day, we arrived at the beach hut.
segments.ipa: /ɑn ðə fɝst deɪ wi ərˈaɪvd æt ðə bitʃ hʌt/

segments.text: There were lots of young people in the other beach huts.
segments.ipa: /ðɛr wɝ lɑts ʌv jʌŋ ˈpipəl ɪn ðə ˈʌðər bitʃ hʌts/

segments.text: Some of them invited us to a party on the first night.
segments.ipa: /sʌm ʌv ðɛm ˌɪnˈvaɪtəd ʌs tu ə ˈpɑrti ɑn ðə fɝst naɪt/

segments.text: Soon after we got there, my boyfriend started flirting with one of the girls at the party.
segments.ipa: /sun ˈæftər wi ɡɑt ðɛr maɪ ˈbɔɪˌfrɛnd ˈstɑrtɪd ˈflɝtɪŋ wɪð wʌn ʌv ðə ɡɝlz æt ðə ˈpɑrti/

segments.text: He didn't dance with me, but spent the evening talking to the girl.
segments.ipa: /hi ˈdɪdənt dæns wɪð mi bʌt spɛnt ðə ˈivnɪŋ ˈtɔkɪŋ tu ðə ɡɝl/

segments.text: The atmosphere was romantic and magical, but not for me.
segments.ipa: /ðə ˈætməsˌfɪr wɑz roʊˈmæntɪk ənd ˈmædʒɪkəl bʌt nɑt fɔr mi/

segments.text: I was angry.
segments.ipa: /aɪ wɑz ˈæŋɡri/

segments.text: We argued about everything after that.
segments.ipa: /wi ˈɑrɡjud əˈbaʊt ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ ˈæftər ðæt/

segments.text: Although we weren't getting along well, I still wanted to go on the safari.
segments.ipa: /ˌɔlˈðoʊ wi ˈwɝənt ˈɡɛtɪŋ əˈlɔŋ wɛl aɪ stɪl ˈwɔntɪd tu ɡoʊ ɑn ðə səˈfɑri/

segments.text: When we got on the bus, I saw the girl from the party.
segments.ipa: /wɛn wi ɡɑt ɑn ðə bʌs aɪ sɔ ðə ɡɝl frʌm ðə ˈpɑrti/

segments.text: That was the end.
segments.ipa: /ðæt wɑz ðə ɛnd/

segments.text: We were camping and we all ate together every night.
segments.ipa: /wi wɝ ˈkæmpɪŋ ənd wi ɔl eɪt təˈɡɛðər ˈɛvəri naɪt/

segments.text: It was terrible.
segments.ipa: /ɪt wɑz ˈtɛrəbəl/

segments.text: I felt so sad and lonely, and my boyfriend looked so happy with the other girl.
segments.ipa: /aɪ fɛlt soʊ sæd ənd ˈloʊnli ənd maɪ ˈbɔɪˌfrɛnd lʊkt soʊ ˈhæpi wɪð ðə ˈʌðər ɡɝl/

segments.text: We broke up when we got back to Los Angeles.
segments.ipa: /wi broʊk ʌp wɛn wi ɡɑt bæk tu loʊs ˈændʒəlɪs/

segments.text: My boyfriend went to Florida with his new girlfriend.
segments.ipa: /maɪ ˈbɔɪˌfrɛnd wɛnt tu ˈflɔrədə wɪð hɪz nu ˈɡɝlˌfrɛnd/

segments.text: I took lots of photos on vacation, but I can't look at them now.

segments.text: I'd love to go back to Kenya one day.

segments.text: But next time, I'm going on my own.
